interactiveRebase.fromCommit.zh-CN: 从此提交开始交互式 Rebase…

interactiveRebase.hint.en: Rewrite a continuous linear segment of the current branch, oldest first. Root commits and merge commits are unsupported. Rebase never pushes automatically.
interactiveRebase.hint.zh-CN: 按从旧到新的顺序改写当前分支的连续线性提交段。不支持根提交和合并提交。Rebase 不会自动推送。

interactiveRebase.start.zh-CN: 起始提交（包含该提交，填写完整 ID）

interactiveRebase.order.en: Commit order, oldest first; Alt+Up/Down to reorder
interactiveRebase.order.zh-CN: 提交顺序（从旧到新）；Alt+上下方向键调整顺序

interactiveRebase.fixup.zh-CN: fixup · 合并并丢弃本条说明

interactiveRebase.combinedMessage.en: Complete message for the combined commit
interactiveRebase.combinedMessage.zh-CN: 合并后提交的完整说明

interactiveRebase.acknowledge.en: I understand that this rewrites commits reachable from locally cached remote refs and can require coordination and a later force push. No Fetch has been performed.
interactiveRebase.acknowledge.zh-CN: 我理解此操作会改写本地缓存远程引用可达的提交，可能需要协作确认及后续强制推送。本次没有执行 Fetch。

interactiveRebase.recovery.en: Original HEAD is retained as a recovery point in Reflog
interactiveRebase.recovery.zh-CN: 原 HEAD 将保留为 Reflog 恢复点

interactiveRebase.execute.zh-CN: 执行已审阅的 Rebase 计划

interactiveRebase.completed.en: Rebase completed. The original history is available in Reflog recovery points.
interactiveRebase.completed.zh-CN: Rebase 已完成。可在 Reflog 恢复点中找到原历史。

interactiveRebase.invalid.en: Keep every original commit exactly once, using drop to remove it. Squash/fixup need an earlier retained commit; reword/squash need a nonempty message.
interactiveRebase.invalid.zh-CN: 每个原提交必须且只能出现一次，删除请使用 drop。squash/fixup 前须有保留的提交；reword/squash 须填写非空说明。

interactiveRebase.changed.en: The plan expired or HEAD/branch changed. Reload the scope before executing.
interactiveRebase.changed.zh-CN: 计划已过期或 HEAD/分支已变化，请重新加载范围后执行。

interactiveRebase.scope.en: Select up to 500 continuous non-merge commits on the current local branch, excluding the root commit. An active Git operation must finish first.
interactiveRebase.scope.zh-CN: 请选择当前本地分支上最多 500 条连续非合并提交，排除根提交。须先完成进行中的 Git 操作。

interactiveRebase.published.en: This range includes commits reachable from cached remote refs. Explicit acknowledgement is required.
interactiveRebase.published.zh-CN: 此范围包含本地缓存远程引用可达的提交，须明确确认风险。

interactiveRebase.dirty.en: Commit or stash all working tree, index, and untracked changes before Rebase.
interactiveRebase.dirty.zh-CN: 请先提交或暂存工作区、索引和未跟踪文件的全部改动。

interactiveRebase.unavailable.en: Interactive Rebase is unavailable in this host.
interactiveRebase.unavailable.zh-CN: 当前宿主不支持交互式 Rebase。

interactiveRebase.emptyPause.en: The current commit has no remaining changes. Keep an empty commit or explicitly skip it.
interactiveRebase.emptyPause.zh-CN: 当前提交已没有剩余改动。可保留为空提交，或明确跳过。

interactiveRebase.skipTitle.zh-CN: 跳过当前 Rebase 提交？

interactiveRebase.skipConfirm.en: Skipping discards the current commit and its conflict-resolution changes. Continue cannot restore the skipped commit.
interactiveRebase.skipConfirm.zh-CN: 跳过会丢弃当前提交及其冲突解决改动。之后点击继续不能恢复已跳过的提交。

interactiveRebase.unavailableState.en: The saved plan or editor helper is missing, changed or does not match this Rebase. Restore the saved files before continuing, or abort.
interactiveRebase.unavailableState.zh-CN: 保存的计划或编辑器辅助文件缺失、变化或与当前 Rebase 不匹配。请先恢复这些文件再继续，或中止操作。

interactiveRebase.scopeDraft.en: The start commit was edited. Load the scope to review a new plan.
interactiveRebase.scopeDraft.zh-CN: 起始提交已编辑。请加载范围并重新审阅计划。
interactiveRebase.scopeDraft.context: Interactive Rebase scope and pause controls

interactiveRebase.reviewPaused.context: Interactive Rebase scope and pause controls

interactiveRebase.alreadyApplied.en: The commit was already replayed. Continue retries the reviewed message; Skip is unavailable. You can abort to restore the original history.
interactiveRebase.alreadyApplied.zh-CN: 提交已完成重放。继续会重试已审阅的说明，此时不能跳过。可中止以恢复原历史。

interactiveRebase.path.en: Interactive Rebase does not support newline characters in the Git directory or runtime path.
interactiveRebase.path.zh-CN: 交互式 Rebase 不支持 Git 目录或运行时路径中包含换行符。
